verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud documents a live preview "for human control" when the agent is stuck on a CAPTCHA. It also documents a `live_view_url` from the `browser.ready` event that lets a human act inside the browser (e.g., entering a 2FA code) and then continue in the same session, and run events can be polled to monitor progress. The documented handoff is mostly a planned checkpoint (stop the run, then continue the session) rather than a clearly described ad-hoc pause-and-takeover. missing for 10: in-depth live-preview docs describing an explicit mid-run pause/takeover/resume flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of live viewing and human takeover.
